## Review checklist

- [ ] Matches what the PO asked for (say which need it serves)
- [ ] Screens only show things; saving and loading go through lib/Repositories
- [ ] New behavior has tests; `flutter test` passes
- [ ] No new large files without a reason (check the "Size of app files" step)
- [ ] Animations, sounds and controllers are stopped and disposed when the screen closes
- [ ] Simple enough for the team to explain at the showcase
- [ ] Synthetic data only; no real personal data
